cmd:
set -e; D=/opt/trading-bot/positions; mkdir -p $D; cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo; git fetch -q origin main || true; git show FETCH_HEAD:bot/positions/pos.py > $D/pos.py; chown -R tbot:tbot $D; cd $D; su -s /bin/sh tbot -c "cd $D && /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python pos.py open XRPUSDT short 1.2600 1.2002 --be-r 1 --lock 0.2 --trail 1.5 --maxh 72 --stake 100 --zone 1.2440 1.2530 --thesis "XRP short: 1d/4h/1h trend down (score -4), bounce into 1h EMA20/50 cluster 1.252-1.2535 rejected, invalidation: close above 4h EMA20 1.2584""; printf "[Unit]
Description=Paper positions tracker
After=network.target
[Service]
User=tbot
ExecStart=/opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python /opt/trading-bot/positions/pos.py loop
Environment=POS_DIR=/opt/trading-bot/positions
Restart=always
Nice=10
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
" > /etc/systemd/system/pos-tracker.service; systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl enable --now pos-tracker; sleep 3; systemctl is-active pos-tracker; su -s /bin/sh tbot -c "cd $D && /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python pos.py status"
